The '''Xr5 Power Assist''' was a type of [[Strength enhancing system/Legends|strength enhancing system]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The system was produced by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] and cost 5500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
